Let $S$ be a submonoid of $A$ such that $B$ is the localization of $A$ at $S$ and the identity map of $K$ is a localization of the $A$-module $K$ at $S$. Then for every fractional ideal $I$ of $A$ in $K$, the $B$-submodule of $K$ underlying…
nodes.title: Extension to a localization is localization

nodes.summary: Let $A$ be an integral domain with fraction field $K$, and let $I$ be a nonzero fractional ideal of $A$ in $K$. Then $I^{-1}$, viewed as an $A$-submodule of $K$, equals the dual submodule of $I$ with respect to the multiplication form $(x, y) \mapsto xy$ on $K$, namely the set $\{x \in K : xy \in A \text{ for all } y \in I\}$, where $A$ is identified with its image in $K$.
nodes.title: The inverse of a nonzero fractional ideal is its multiplication dual

nodes.summary: Let $A$ be an integral domain with fraction field $K$ and let $I$ be an invertible fractional ideal of $A$ in $K$. This is the $A$-linear isomorphism $\operatorname{Hom}_A(\operatorname{Hom}_A(I, A), A) \to I$ inverse to the canonical evaluation map $I \to \operatorname{Hom}_A(\operatorname{Hom}_A(I, A), A)$, $x \mapsto (f \mapsto f(x))$.
nodes.title: Double dual of an invertible fractional ideal

nodes.summary: Let $A$ be an integral domain with fraction field $K$ and let $I$ be a nonzero fractional ideal of $A$ in $K$. This is the $A$-linear isomorphism $\operatorname{Hom}_A(I, A) \to I^{-1}$, with $I^{-1}$ viewed as an $A$-submodule of $K$, sending $f$ to the unique $x \in I^{-1}$ such that $f(y) = xy$ in $K$ for all $y \in I$ (where $A$ is identified with its image in $K$).
nodes.title: Dual of a nonzero fractional ideal is its inverse

nodes.summary: Let $A$ be an integral domain with fraction field $K$, let $M$ be a nonzero $A$-submodule of $K$, and let $\varphi \colon \operatorname{Hom}_A(M, A) \to M^\vee$ be the isomorphism onto the dual submodule $M^\vee$ of $M$ for the multiplication form $(x, y) \mapsto xy$ on $K$. Then for every $f \in \operatorname{Hom}_A(M, A)$ and every $m \in M$, the image of $f(m)$ in $K$ equals $\varphi(f) \, m$.
nodes.title: Formula for the isomorphism onto the multiplication dual

nodes.summary: Let $A$ be an integral domain with fraction field $K$, identify $A$ with its image in $K$, and let $M$ be a nonzero $A$-submodule of $K$. Let $M^\vee = \{x \in K : xy \in A \text{ for all } y \in M\}$ be the dual submodule of $M$ for the multiplication form $(x, y) \mapsto xy$ on $K$. This is the $A$-linear isomorphism $\operatorname{Hom}_A(M, A) \to M^\vee$ inverse to the map sending $x \in M^\vee$ to the…
nodes.title: Dual of a nonzero submodule of the fraction field

nodes.summary: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $K$ a field that is an $A$-algebra, and write $1$ for the $A$-submodule $A \cdot 1$ of $K$. For every $A$-submodule $M$ of $K$, the dual submodule of $M$ with respect to the multiplication form $(x, y) \mapsto xy$ on $K$ equals the quotient $1 / M$, the set of $x \in K$ with $xy \in A \cdot 1$ for all $y \in M$.
nodes.title: The multiplication dual is a colon quotient

nodes.summary: Let $A$ be an integral domain with fraction field $K$ and let $M$ be a nonzero $A$-submodule of $K$. For every $A$-linear map $f \colon M \to A$ there is $x \in K$ such that the image of $f(m)$ in $K$ equals $xm$ for every $m \in M$.
nodes.title: Functionals on a submodule of the fraction field are multiplications

nodes.title: Over a Noetherian domain, extension to a localization commutes with division

nodes.summary: Let $A$ be a Noetherian local integral domain with fraction field $K$, and let $I$ be a nonzero fractional ideal of $A$ in $K$. Then $I$ is invertible if and only if $I$ is principal.
nodes.title: Invertible fractional ideals of a Noetherian local domain are principal

nodes.summary: The inverse/localization inequality follows from equality.
nodes.title: Inverse of a localized fractional ideal is bounded by localization

For a maximal ideal $\mathfrak m$ of $A$, write $A_{\mathfrak m}$ for the localization of $A$ at $\mathfrak m$ and $I_{\mathfrak m}$ for the localization of a fractional ideal $I$ of $A$ in $K$, the $A_{\mathfrak m}$-submodule of $K$ generated by $I$. A fractional ideal $I$ of $A$ in $K$ is locally principal if for every maximal ideal $\mathfrak m$ of $A$ the…
nodes.title: Locally principal fractional ideal

nodes.summary: A nonzero fractional ideal of a Noetherian domain is invertible iff it is locally principal.
nodes.title: Corollary 3.5

nodes.summary: Theorem 3.2 (prime-ideal form). A fractional ideal of a Noetherian domain is invertible iff its localization at every prime ideal is invertible.
nodes.title: Theorem 3.2

nodes.summary: Theorem 3.2 (maximal-ideal form). A fractional ideal of a Noetherian domain is invertible iff its localization at every maximal ideal is invertible.

nodes.title: Localization commutes with inverting fractional ideals

nodes.title: Localization of a fractional ideal at a prime

nodes.title: Localization commutes with division by a finitely generated submodule

nodes.summary: Let $A$ be an integral domain with fraction field $K$, identify $A$ with its image in $K$, and let $M$ be a nonzero $A$-submodule of $K$. Let $M^\vee = \{x \in K : xy \in A \text{ for all } y \in M\}$ be the dual submodule of $M$ for the multiplication form $(x, y) \mapsto xy$ on $K$. Then the $A$-linear map $M^\vee \to \operatorname{Hom}_A(M, A)$ sending $x$ to the functional $y \mapsto xy$ on $M$ is surjective.
nodes.title: Every functional comes from the multiplication dual

nodes.summary: For every field $K$, the $K$-bilinear form $(x, y) \mapsto xy$ on $K$ is nondegenerate: if $xy = 0$ for all $y \in K$ then $x = 0$, and if $xy = 0$ for all $x \in K$ then $y = 0$.
nodes.title: Multiplication is a nondegenerate bilinear form

nodes.summary: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $K$ a field that is an $A$-algebra. Then every nonzero $A$-submodule $M$ of $K$ spans $K$ as a $K$-vector space.
nodes.title: A nonzero submodule spans the field

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
